text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The shopping district is surprisingly crowded on our way back from running errands.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hm? I wonder what all the excitement is about over there…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Step right up and try your luck with our New Year's raffle! This year's grand prize is a hot spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot hamburger steak! Second-prize winners get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize winners can take home a single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Don't let this opportunity pass you by! Get a ticket now and spin for your chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: They're giving out deluxe carrot hamburger steaks?! Trainer, we have to try this raffle out!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! We need tickets! Hmm… I know! I'll go do a little shopping!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! I think I bought too much. There are so many dishes I wanna make if we win carrots.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Okay, here I go! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono gives the raffle machine a powerful spin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A small plastic ball drops from the tumbler's opening…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a grand-prize winner! Come and get the coupon for your hot spring vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: O-o-oh my gosh! I won the vacation ticket!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: And it's for this inn?! They're famous for serving really buono food!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: This is amazing! We should go on this trip together, Trainer!
choice_data_list: You want me to go with you?
You want me to go with you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Of course! ☆ Just imagine how great it'll be, getting to eat such yummy food together!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh… but we don't really have time to go now, do we? I still have so many races to run…
choice_data_list: How about we go once things calm down?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: That's a good idea. We'll be able to relax better if we don't have to worry about my schedule!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: All right, let's wait for now. I'll take good care of the ticket until then.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! I wonder what they'll serve? Sashimi? Steak? Hot pot, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Whatever it is, I'm sure there'll be lots to learn from the different flavors! I'll have to memorize how the food tastes for reference!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: We've got to make sure we're nice and hungry when we go! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Hishi Akebono and I make a brand-new promise with each other.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have another first-prize winner! Congratulations! You get one deluxe carrot hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Wooow! It looks delicious!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hm? Wait… Is this… Oh, it is! This is the hamburger steak they serve at a really famous restaurant!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I've been wanting to eat there someday. What an incredible twist of fate!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Thank you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: You should have it with me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Of course! Sharing food makes it taste twice as delicious!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: And sharing it with someone you really like makes it four times as yummy! Amazing, right?
choice_data_list: Well, I can't say no to that!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Good answer! Now let's go home!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Since I bought so many ingredients, I'll make us soup and salad for sides too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After we get home, we enjoy the mouthwateringly delicious deluxe carrot hamburger steak together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono manages to reverse-engineer the steak's recipe and recreate it exactly a few days later… but that's a story for another time.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: We got a second-prize winner! It's your lucky day! You're going home with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yay, I did it! I can make sooo much with these!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I can make meat and potatoes, curry, stew, carrot hamburger steaks, carrot steaks, salads and, oh! Cake and jelly too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: You'd better get ready for dinner tonight, because I'm going to make sure your heart will be as full and happy and as your tummy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm honored that she's so enthusiastic to cook for me, but I don't think the two of us can realistically eat all these carrots.
choice_data_list: I don't think we can finish these alone.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh, good point! It would've been bad if we ended up with a bunch of leftovers.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Okay, I've got an idea! I'll try to invite some others to join us!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hey, Maya! I was thinking about throwing a carrot party for everybody today. Do you think you can come?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Great! ♪ I'm glad you can make it! See you then!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yay, she agreed to come! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Next, I just have to ask Curren, Biko, and Kawakami. I wonder if Fuji and Hishiama can make it too?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Haha! This is exciting! I can't wait! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Dinner that night is much livelier than usual.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Would you lookie here! You've won the third prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Aw man, I was so close! Still, this carrot looks real tasty! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It's a bit thin but it's got some heft, and its roots are so evenly spaced! I bet it'll turn out soft and sweet once it's cooked!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: And to make the most of this carrot…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'll simmer it with some other ingredients in soy sauce and make a super buono dish out of it! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterwards, I'm treated to the delicately simmered dish she makes, and true to her word, it's absolutely buono.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Don't be shy if you want seconds! There's plenty more to have! ☆

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled a blank one! Take this pack of tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh… What a shame!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Aww… I was really looking forward to making a grand and buono feast for dinner too…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh well! I'm sure these veggies I bought will make just a good a dinner!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Some days just don't go your way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's clearly trying to stay positive, but her expression is a little downcast when we leave the shopping district together.
